items.text: Ravens downgraded WR Zay Flowers to OUT for Sunday vs Saints due to hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring; downgraded Saturday after limited/practice issues.
items.implication: Remove from all lineups; Ravens WR hierarchy shifts heavily.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining BAL pass-catchers including Mark Andrews and Rashod Bateman.

items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT for Sunday vs Patriots due to foot injury.
items.implication: PIT WR depth chart opens; Metcalf/others elevated role.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/targets for DK Metcalf and secondary WRs; TE Pat Freiermuth volume bump possible.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins (hamstring) officially ruled OUT for Sunday vs Bengals; injury from midweek practice, not believed long-term but multi-game risk noted.
items.why: Hamstring tweak Wednesday; DNPs follow; Schefter source said not serious but status jeopardized then confirmed out.
items.implication: Major volume loss for HOU passing game; Stroud impacted.
items.opportunity: Targets to Dalton Schultz, Kayshon Boutte, Xavier Hutchinson, Jaylin Noel.

items.text: ETR The Rundown for Week 2 is live (game-by-game content review, updated early Sun AM); Cheap WR Volume and shows (ETM/Lineup Build) active for status/projections assumptions.
items.why: Sunday mode comprehensive status + beneficiary + projection hub.
items.implication: Primary source for last-minute assumptions and cheap volume.
items.opportunity: Monitor for any final IN/OUT or role notes pre-kickoff.

items.text: Rams officially listed WR Puka Nacua questionable for MNF vs Giants (hip); McVay noted groin soreness post-Thursday practice, different from camp issue; Whittington doubtful (quad); likely pregame decision.
items.why: Hip/groin soreness; DNP Saturday; McVay comments.
items.implication: Monday night trap; need pivot ready before early games lock.
items.opportunity: If out + Whittington out: heavier TE (Ferguson/Parkinson) and WR Konata Mumpfield/Malachi Fields bump; Davante Adams role expands.

items.text: With Joe Burrow listed questionable for Sunday at Houston, Bengals elevated QB Josh Johnson from practice squad; Burrow expected to play per reports.
items.why: Back tightness; full practice Friday; coach/player optimism; elevation is contingency.
items.implication: Start Burrow if active; monitor inactives closely.
items.opportunity: If unexpectedly out, Josh Johnson emergency; Chase/Higgins still high volume expected.

items.text: With TE Brock Bowers doubtful for Sunday, Raiders elevated TE Chris Myarick and WR Cody White from practice squad.
items.why: Knee (meniscus); limited Friday, pregame test expected; elevations signal likely inactive.
items.implication: Plan without Bowers; late decision risk for 4pm slate.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer primary TE beneficiary for targets/routes; WR volume spillover.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson removed from injury report/good to go after ankle; expected to debut but Rhamondre Stevenson likely retains lead role/snaps after 86% Week 1.
items.why: Full practice; player says ready; prior uncertainty resolved.
items.implication: Henderson flex upside; Stevenson floor remains but snap share compressed.
items.opportunity: 10+ touch potential split; monitor actual deployment/carries/routes.

items.text: Ladd McConkey questionable (rib); ETR Cheap WR Volume flags Quentin Johnston and Tre Harris for 5+ target projections and large roles/22%+ shares if McConkey out in friendly Raiders matchup (both saw elevated Week 1 post-exit).
items.why: Rib; limited Friday after DNPs; contingency volume mapped.
items.implication: Monitor late window; QJ viable regardless but spikes if out.
items.opportunity: QJ/Harris inherit large route/target shares vs LV if McConkey inactive.

items.text: HATE Travis Etienne @ BAL: matched Kendre Miller rush attempts Week 1, most points via air; Alvin Kamara expected back further squeezes role in underdog script.
items.why: Reduced early-down + Kamara return splits committee further; negative game script.
items.opportunity: Kamara reclaims third-down/passing; Miller early downs possible.

items.text: LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), 40% routes targeted (team lead); Indy allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry Week 1.
items.opportunity: High snap/touch/target share + goal-line; pass-game involvement confirmed.

items.text: LOVE Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization score Week 1 (tied Bijan league lead); 19% target share last 10 games; 25+ touches in 3 of last 4.
items.why: Elite utilization and consistent receiving role in soft matchup.
items.opportunity: High util/target share sustained; Chargers D not scary.

items.text: LOVE Bucky Irving vs CLE: RB9 util Week 1, 26% target share, 100% RB red-zone/goal-line touches; CLE allowed 121 rush/4.8 YPC.
items.why: Passing + every RZ touch confirmed; favorable run matchup.

items.text: LOVE Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz Week 1; career 93 yds/18 PPG with Wentz; Bears allowed 10+ YPT to CAR WRs.
items.why: Massive volume with Wentz + soft secondary.
items.opportunity: Target share dominance and historical chemistry.

items.text: LOVE Dak Prescott vs WAS: home smash spot; WAS torched 14.5 YPC/3 TDs Week 1; DAL top-5 implied total (~27) in high-total game.
items.why: Elite home environment + weak opponent pass D + high total.

items.text: HATE Marvin Harrison Jr. vs SEA: only 8% target share Week 1 (5th on team), zero RZ looks; SEA tough vs WRs historically.
items.why: Alarmingly low target share + tough matchup.
items.opportunity: Volume not materializing; others ahead in hierarchy.

items.text: LOVE DeVonta Smith @ TEN: 27% target share + 13.7 aDOT (3 deep) Week 1; TEN allowed 85% catch/16 YPR and high PPG to WRs.
items.why: Strong volume + deep aDOT in soft secondary.
items.opportunity: Target share and explosive play potential.

items.text: LOVE Dalton Kincaid vs DET: top-5 TE util Week 1, 69% route rate (higher than any 2025 game); DET allowed 27 fantasy pts to TEs Week 1.
items.why: Route participation spike + soft TE matchup.
